Our learning approach

A strong foundation for a successful future. At Smart Kids, we follow a child-centred learning approach based on five essential principles:

  1. 1

    Understand

    Build strong conceptual knowledge.

  2. 2

    Practise

    Develop skills through regular activities.

  3. 3

    Explore

    Encourage curiosity and creativity.

  4. 4

    Express

    Improve communication and confidence.

  5. 5

    Achieve

    Celebrate individual progress and accomplishments.

We believe that consistent encouragement, effective teaching, and a positive environment help children discover their true potential.

Why choose Smart Kids?

Every Child Matters. Every Skill Counts.

  • Individual AttentionWe understand that children learn at different speeds. Our teaching approach focuses on individual learning needs.
  • Experienced EducatorsOur programmes are guided by trained educators with practical teaching and child development experience.
  • Strong Academic FoundationWe help children improve their understanding of subjects through systematic practice and engaging activities.
  • Activity-Based LearningWe make learning interactive through games, practical exercises, creative projects, and hands-on activities.
  • Confidence and CommunicationOur programmes encourage children to express themselves clearly, communicate confidently, and develop a positive attitude.
  • Flexible Learning OptionsWe offer after-school, weekend, online, and offline learning opportunities to support different schedules.

Where learning meets confidence and creativity

Smart Kids Skill Development Centre was founded in August 2015 by R. Saranyadevi, an educator, entrepreneur, and professional skill development trainer with over 12 years of experience in education and training.

Our centre was established with a simple vision: to provide children with a supportive learning environment where academic excellence meets practical life skills.

We focus not only on improving marks but also on developing communication, creativity, concentration, problem-solving abilities, discipline, and self-confidence.

At Smart Kids Skill Development Centre, we believe every child has unique talents and unlimited potential. Established in 2015, we have helped children strengthen their academic foundations, improve communication skills, develop creativity, and become confident, independent learners.

With experienced educators, personalised attention, and engaging teaching methods, we make learning enjoyable, meaningful, and effective.

Our vision

To inspire every child to become a confident, capable, creative, and lifelong learner.

Our mission

To deliver engaging, affordable, and personalised learning experiences that strengthen academic knowledge, develop essential skills, and encourage every child's individual potential.

Questions parents ask

Timings, batch size, fees, progress updates
What age can my child join?

Our programmes are for children aged 4 and above.

Is Smart Kids a tuition centre?

Smart Kids is a skill development and tuition centre in Tiruchengode. Along with teaching school subjects, exam preparation and Olympiad practice, we run courses in abacus, Vedic maths, phonics, spoken English, Hindi, Tamil, handwriting, art and life skills.

Which courses do you offer?

We offer 40 courses in six programmes: Academic Excellence, Language and Communication, Brain Development and Mental Maths, Handwriting and Creative Writing, Art, Creativity and Activities, and Personality and Life Skills.

Do you offer online classes?

Yes. Classes run online, and offline at our centres in Tiruchengode.

Do you run summer camps?

Yes. Our summer camps and holiday learning clubs run Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM, and combine academics, creativity, physical activity and play.

When do classes run?

We run after-school and weekend batches. Call us and we will suggest a batch that fits your child's school timetable.

How many children are in a batch?

Batches are kept small so every child gets individual attention. Ask us about the batch for your child's course.

How much are the fees?

Fees depend on the course and how often your child attends. Send an enquiry and we will share the details for the course you choose.

Do you offer one-to-one support?

Yes, individual learning support is available.

How will I know my child is improving?

Ask us how we share updates with parents for your child's course.
